headline: 4 stories worth your time — mostly marketing & content. Start with: OpenAI to start showing ads on ChatGPT’s free and Go tiers in India

items.title: OpenAI to start showing ads on ChatGPT’s free and Go tiers in India
items.summary: OpenAI has more than 100 million weekly active ChatGPT users in India, a huge chunk of whom are on the free or the lower-priced Go tiers.
items.whyItMatters: Distribution work. Judge it by whether it gets you in front of more of the right people for the same effort.
actions: Check whether the free tier covers your actual volume before paying for the equivalent elsewhere.

items.title: Google’s AI Mode can now track flight prices, help book hotels, and more
items.summary: The updates indicate that Google is looking to position AI Mode as an AI travel agent of sorts, as it's moving beyond simply helping users find information to actually handling parts of the trip-planning and booking process.
items.whyItMatters: This moves your cost base. Even small per-seat changes compound when you are paying out of revenue rather than a budget line.
actions: Compare against what you currently pay for the same job and reprice if the gap is material.
Worth an hour to set up if you are still coordinating bookings by email.

items.title: Meta executive leaves for OpenAI as the social media giant faces growing scrutiny in India
items.summary: Sandhya Devanathan will oversee some OpenAI operations across Southeast Asia and Australia in her new role.
items.whyItMatters: Distribution work. Judge it by whether it gets you in front of more of the right people for the same effort.
actions: Use it to increase output on a channel that already converts — not to open a new one.

items.title: Enterprise AI's real risk isn't autonomous agents. It's the complexity between them.
items.summary: Presented by Gravitee Agent complexity is the insidious shadow lurking inside enterprises right now that needs a light shone on it. That’s because enterprises don't deploy a single agent and watch it run, they deploy fleets, each one calling APIs,…
items.whyItMatters: This is back-office time. Anything here competes directly with hours you are personally spending on admin.
actions: Practical walkthrough — read it once and decide, rather than bookmarking it.
